{"predictors": [
{"name": "Revenue Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of revenue concentration across the top 5 customers, using Compustat customer data, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated revenue streams may face higher uncertainty and risk, leading to higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of year-over-year changes in total employees, using Compustat employment data, over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile employee growth may be more susceptible to economic downturns, leading to higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Sentiment", "construction": "Calculate the average sentiment score of news articles mentioning the firm's suppliers, using Thomson Reuters News Archive data, over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with suppliers experiencing negative sentiment may face higher supply chain risk, leading to higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Innovation Network Centrality", "construction": "Calculate the eigenvector centrality of the firm in a network of patent citations, using USPTO patent data, over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms at the center of innovation networks may have greater access to knowledge and resources, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Earnings Guidance Dispersion", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of analyst earnings guidance, using Thomson Reuters I/B/E/S data, over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with more dispersed earnings guidance may face higher uncertainty and risk, leading to higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Connectedness", "construction": "Calculate the number of shared board members between the firm and other S&P 500 companies, using RiskMetrics corporate governance data, as of the most recent fiscal year-end", "rationale": "Firms with more connected governance structures may be more susceptible to groupthink and poor decision-making, leading to lower returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Market Fluidity", "construction": "Calculate the average turnover rate of the top 5 products, using Compustat segment data, over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with more fluid product markets may be more adaptable to changing consumer preferences, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Revenue Diversification", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of revenue diversification across geographic segments, using Compustat geographic segment data, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with more diversified revenue streams may face lower country-specific risk, leading to lower required returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Carbon Footprint Intensity", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of carbon emissions to total revenues, using Trucost environmental data, as of the most recent fiscal year-end", "rationale": "Firms with higher carbon footprint intensity may face higher regulatory and reputational risk, leading to higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Portfolio Diversification", "construction": "Calculate the average number of other board seats held by the firm's board members, using RiskMetrics corporate governance data, as of the most recent fiscal year-end", "rationale": "Firms with more diversified board member portfolios may have more experienced and well-connected directors, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
